name: Sarah Jenkins
subject: SDE Role / Dual Degree Experience Inquiry
message: Hi Abhishek, I came across your portfolio and was really impressed by your dual-degree work at IIT Madras and CSVTU Bhilai, especially your multi-tenant Trekking Management Application (TMA) setup. We have an opening for an Associate Backend Engineer on our Cloud Systems team. Are you currently exploring full-time or internship opportunities?

name: Devansh Verma
subject: Question on Examination Portal (LMS) Telemetry Engine
message: Hello Abhishek! I tested your Examination Management Portal on AWS. How did you structure the real-time score distribution charts in Chart.js with Gunicorn's low-memory thread workers on the 1GB EC2 instance? Would love to connect and exchange thoughts on low-footprint Python backend optimization.

name: Rajiv Mehta
subject: Full-Stack Collaboration on SaaS Platform
message: Hey Abhishek, loved the tenant isolation architecture on TMA. We are building a workflow automation SaaS and are looking for someone strong in Flask, Docker, and PostgreSQL. Let me know if you have time for a quick 15-minute chat this week.
